title: Sivakumarin Sabadham
desc: A man belongs to a weaver's family and strives to overcome multiple challenges in order to make his dreams come true of setting up a textile company.

title: Takkar
desc: A man who wants to be a millionaire meets a woman with a distaste for money. Their chance encounter, however, leads to an unexpected adventure.

title: Raatchasi
desc: Lieutenant Colonel Geetha Rani implements different plans to reform an undisciplined government school. However, she faces numerous challenges in her way, including a corrupt MLA.

title: Kalavani
desc: Arivazhagan, a mischievous young man, falls in love with Maheshwari, who belongs to the rival village. He abducts her and marries her after she confesses her feelings for him.

title: Race Gurram
desc: In an attempt to put an end to the schemes of their enemy, two brothers join forces and stop at nothing to destroy the reign of a gangster who aspires to be a politician.

title: Bheemla Nayak
desc: A battle begins between SI Bheemla Nayak, a righteous policeman, and Daniel Shekhar, an ex-havildar, when Daniel tricks Bheemla into surrendering to corruption.

title: Chikku Bukku
desc: Arjun and Anu fall in love with each other on a train journey. When Anu's father learns about their relationship, he remembers that he shares an unpleasant history with Arjun's father.

title: Kanchivaram
desc: Vengadam promises his newborn daughter that he will drape her in a silk sari on her wedding day. However, he faces various problems while he strives to fulfil his promise.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Gentleman Sathya
desc: Sathyam and Chaitra meet unexpectedly in their pursuit of making quick money. Soon after they fall in love, Sathyam encounters Padmanabham, a criminal on the run from the Indian police.

title: Carbon
desc: Shankar has dreams that often come true. One day, when his father meets with an accident, he tries to find the identity of the hit-and-run driver through his dreams.

title: Mister
desc: When Chai finds out that Meera loves Siddharth, he does everything in his power to unite them, even though he is madly in love with her.

title: Mirai
desc: When a vicious villain sets out to claim nine sacred books that hold the secret to immortality, the guardian of the ninth book ties a happy-go-lucky orphan's destiny to the quest to protect them.

title: Sakka Podu Podu Raja
desc: Santa turns Bhavani, a gangster, into his enemy after helping his friend elope with the thug's sister. Later, Santa falls in love with a girl, who turns out to be Bhavani's younger sister.

title: Thuparivaalan
desc: An experienced detective investigates the death of a child's pet dog and inadvertently unravels a sinister web of unsolved murders.
After witnessing repeated nightmares of a woman being killed, an investigative journalist goes on to find out its truth.
